channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Jason Matheson’s sidekick, Alexis Thompson, dropped from MyTalk radio show
item.description: Management didn’t renew Thompson’s contract due to financial constraints.

item.title: Twins All-Star pitcher Pablo López likely will miss the 2026 season because of elbow injury
item.description: López left the first full-squad practice Monday because of discomfort in his pitching elbow.

item.title: Company withdraws plan to expand mine into Mississippi River
item.description: The proposal for the mine on Grey Cloud Island near Cottage Grove drew criticism from nearby residents and Dakota County officials.

item.title: Mike Conley returns to Timberwolves after being traded twice at the deadline
item.description: The Charlotte Hornets bought out Mike Conley’s contract, enabling him to return to Minnesota for a pro-rated minimum deal.

item.title: Journalist, activist plead not guilty to federal charges tied to St. Paul church protest
item.description: Another protester pleaded not guilty to their charges during the brief arraignment.

item.title: Snowstorm to pummel Minnesota’s Arrowhead region
item.description: The Twin Cities could see rain or thunderstorms as the system passes by. Snow is possible later in the week.

item.title: Slain DFL Leader Melissa Hortman is remembered for legacy of service as lawmakers reconvene
item.description: It was a somber opening to the legislative session, which will be dominated by fallout from a year of upheaval in the state.

item.title: FBI, St. Paul police probing ICE arrest that resulted in skull fractures
item.description: Minnesota and federal authorities are investigating the alleged beating of a Mexican citizen by immigration officers last month, seeking to identify what caused the eight skull fractures that landed the man in the intensive care unit of a Minneapolis hospital.

item.title: Should Minneapolis deny liquor licenses to hotels that housed ICE agents? City Council debates it.
item.description: The City Council held a public hearing on the liquor licenses for the Canopy by Hilton and Depot Renaissance Hotel.

item.title: This suburb is likely the first Minnesota city to hit pause on large-scale data centers
item.description: As AI fuels a boom in data centers, cities are looking for ways to regulate them. Eagan is likely the first to pause new or expanding data centers to study them.
